enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Accuracy +11: Passive: +11 Competence bonus to attack rolls
Deadly +6: +6 Competence bonus to weapon damage.
Demonic Shield: Each time you are hit in melee combat there is a chance that a shield of demonic energy will grant you a +30 Profane bonus to temporary hit points.
Legendary Armor-Piercing 2%: Passive: +2% Legendary bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
